teaser: Web Summit 2026, the plan: usage first, an asset, a page and a link for every person, a summit newsroom, and two agentic workflows.
core_idea: For Web Summit 2026 a five-person team pursues usage before the sale, with five-minute onboarding, public-source intelligence, outreach tailored to one person and content for traffic, all run by one method, an asset, a page and a link, from a Web Summit newsroom of its own, while the team learns the two agentic workflows, starting with the scheduled website workflow because a page is cheap to undo.
